prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Marketing Assistant
You will be making instagram posts on canva, and uploading them into cloud campaign. We have professional photos that were taken for each business. They will be uploaded into a dropbox file. You will download the files and upload them into canva. Take the uploaded pictures into canva and put them together to make an instagram and facebook post. Then upload that post into cloud campaign. We will approve all the posts and the rest of the process is automated.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need someone to take your professional photos from Dropbox, assemble them into polished Instagram and Facebook posts in Canva, and then upload the approved content into Cloud Campaign so your posting process stays organized and automated.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be a strong fit for this role because I’m comfortable working carefully with organized digital workflows and handling recurring content tasks with consistency. While my background is in data analysis and visualization, the same strengths that support clean reporting and dashboard work also apply well to marketing support: attention to detail, accuracy, file organization, and following a process exactly as required.

With 5 years of experience, I’ve built a habit of working methodically and keeping projects neat, structured, and easy to review. For this role, that means I can reliably download the photos from Dropbox, place them into Canva, combine them into clean social media graphics, and upload the final posts into Cloud Campaign for approval. I understand the importance of keeping the visuals consistent with your brand and making sure each post is prepared in a format that is ready for review and automation.

I also work well with repeatable tasks and clear instructions, which makes me a good match for a process where the posts are approved before the rest of the workflow runs automatically. I’m comfortable handling repetitive production work without losing quality, and I pay attention to details that matter, like layout balance, image placement, and making sure each file is uploaded correctly.

If you’re looking for someone dependable who can help keep your Instagram and Facebook content moving smoothly from Dropbox to Canva to Cloud Campaign, I’d be glad to support your team. I’d be happy to follow your process closely and help make the posting workflow efficient, organized, and stress-free.
